method: Method B — launch story. PPC Guru launched the account ~Mar 2026 (first data month). Baseline = first complete month (Mar 2026). Most recent complete quarter is Q2 2026 (Apr-Jun); most recent complete month is Jul 2026. Because lead volume is low and roughly flat, the study is treated as early-stage (Needs Review, Low confidence).
genuine_lead_definition: Genuine leads = PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM conversions. This account records no vanity local actions or outbound clicks, so metrics.conversions already equals genuine leads.

quarterly_genuine_leads.note: Q1 2026 is a single partial launch month (Mar).

changes_summary.reach_impressions: 475 (Mar) to 18,021 (Jul) — ~38x expansion after Performance Max added

presentation_note: Only ~5 months of data and low, roughly flat lead volume. The story is an early-stage launch with a clean tracking foundation and a sharply expanded reach base in July; more months are needed to prove a scaled cost per lead. No metric is inflated or spun.
